transfer_suffix_note: Text transport/apply_patch normalized some CRLF and terminal newline bytes. Original newline/BOM variants were restored only when matching the exact pinned Git blob SHA. No content changes remain for exact matches.
claim_scope: Complete selected textual inventory at pinned directory trees. Lexical search corpus, not a claim that all contents received manual semantic review.
published_source_manifest_note: Same source entries as downloaded map; local paths and redundant URLs omitted. Immutable URL = https://github.com/{repository}/blob/{ref}/{path}, URL-encode path spaces; snapshot selected by corpus.
lfs_validation_limit: Git blob checks attest the four LFS pointer files, not their unfetched large payloads.
